name: June
objective: Stop summer lapses with flexibility, not discounts; fill weekday 10–12 and weekend 4–7 pm (27–41% full) with students.
strategy:
Out of Office.

Commercial job: Stop summer lapses with flexibility, not discounts; fill weekday 10–12 and weekend 4–7 pm (27–41% full) with students.

Newcomer: Home for the Holidays (“Back in town? A week unlimited, then 20% off if you stay.”). Summer visitors and returning students need a short, intense entry and a reason to commit before they leave again.

Newcomer: Golden Hours (“Student hours, student price: 25% off.”). Fills Kwality's emptiest slots (27–41% full) with a younger audience; the discount only exists where seats would otherwise be empty.

Winback: Out of Office, Not Out of Shape (“Freeze when you fly. Train when you're home. 20% off.”). Travel is the most common lapse reason; freezes answer it and the 20% gets the decision made.

Renewal: The Pause Button (“Three months, 15% off, freeze as often as you like.”). Travel is the main reason to let a membership lapse; flexibility plus 15% moves 1 Month members onto 3 Months before the summer.
notes:
Moment: Golden Hours launch for students and under-25s; 'Postcard Wall' where travelling members send a photo of their travel workout.
Build: new clients 42 buyers × ₹12,000 = ₹5.0L; reactivation 32 × ₹11,468 = ₹3.7L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹2.8L; renewals ₹15.0L. First visits needed 140 vs 128 last year (1.09×); CRM leads needed 280 vs 129 last year.

items.detail: Set up Home for the Holidays in Momence (All June.): 7-Day Unlimited Intro for ₹1,999 — ₹1,999 credited and 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) if you buy within 72 hours.
Set up Golden Hours in Momence (1 Jun–15 Jul.): An 8-class pack at 25% off list — valid for classes Mon–Fri 10 am–12 pm and Sat–Sun 4–7 pm.
Set up Out of Office, Not Out of Shape in Momence (All June.): 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) — 2 extra freezes and a written travel workout plan.
Set up The Pause Button in Momence (All June.): 3 Months Unlimited at 15% off (₹49,177) — unlimited freezes, used within 6 months of purchase.
Brief the team on the 4 June offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch Home for the Holidays to First-time clients.
Launch Golden Hours to Students and under-25s.
Launch Out of Office, Not Out of Shape to Lapsed clients.
Launch The Pause Button to 1 Month and 3 Months members renewing in June.
Run the month's moment: Golden Hours launch for students and under-25s; 'Postcard Wall' where travelling members send a photo of their travel workout.

Weekly check: Home for the Holidays: Intro conversion (target 40%). | Golden Hours: Golden Hours fill; repeat purchases. | Out of Office, Not Out of Shape: Freeze usage; purchases. | The Pause Button: 3M renewals and 1M→3M upgrades.
Mid-month review against ₹26.5L: by the 15th aim for about half of 169 renewals, 32 reactivations and 42 new buyers (140 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Close June: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief July's offers.
